Corroboration: a probe polled the live homepage `<title>` every 90 seconds for **50 attempts (~75 minutes)** waiting for it to change to the value merged in #12284. It never changed. Final readings:

```
homepage title: ObjectStack — Apps small enough for AI to hold whole.   age: 8311
homepage canonical: (absent)
docs h1 count: 2                                                        age: 7859
docs canonical: (absent)
mdx x-robots-tag: (absent)                                              age: 7863
robots.txt: (still the three-line version, no Allow: /llms.txt)         age: 8240
```

Ages are now ~2.3 hours and rising monotonically, which is the signature of a generation nobody has replaced rather than of a cache that keeps being refilled.

Still pinned. `dpl_2nfWjGjSwZjakVEmUG1kBWD6697r` unchanged.

The count of merged-but-invisible work from epic #12243 is now **eight** PRs: #12262, #12284, #12303, #12305, #12325, #12351, #12355, #12364. Everything in that list passed the merge queue with full CI and is on `main`; none of it is reachable by a user or a crawler.

**Root cause found — the maintainer performed exactly the action this card requested** (read the Vercel deployment list) and pasted the failing production build log in the PM session, 2026-08-27, verbatim:

```
15:45:30.171 @objectstack/spec:build:  ELIFECYCLE  Command failed with exit code 137.
15:45:30.206 @objectstack/spec#build:  ERROR  command (/vercel/path0/packages/spec) /vercel/.local/share/pnpm/.tools/pnpm/10.31.0/bin/pnpm run build exited (137)
15:45:30.234  ERROR  run failed: command  exited (137)
15:45:30.307 Error: Command "cd ../.. && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/docs" exited with 137
```

Exit 137 = 128 + SIGKILL: the build container's OOM killer. Every production build since the ~16:55 2026-08-25 window has been dying this way, which is why `data-dpl-id` never moved — the mystery this card measured is fully explained.

Per this card's own protocol (*"If it turns out a build is failing, that failure is the real card and this one closes into it"*): the failure card is **#12677**, dispatched to a dev seat. The `data-dpl-id` re-check command migrates there as the post-merge verification, and epic #12243's site-level verification resumes once the id moves.

Closing into #12677.
